title: Section 109 CPC — Appeal to the Supreme Court

content.overview: A Code appeal to the Supreme Court from a High Court civil judgment, decree or final order needs a High Court certificate: substantial question of law of general importance that ought to be decided by the Supreme Court.
content.study: Article 136 special leave is the usual path when the certificate is refused. Section 109 does not replace the Constitution. It is the Code's certificate appeal.
